text: Providing supportive housing is essential to ending the homelessness crisis faced by our City. Yet the Province’s budget, released on March 24, fails to commit the funding desperately needed in order to address the crisis we are facing. The City, with the support of the Federal Government, is on track to deliver 1,250 new supportive housing units, which will soon be ready to be occupied by those experiencing homelessness. Of those, 1,100 supportive housing units still require operating funding. The Province is responsible for the operating funding needed to operate these affordable apartments and to provide the on-site wrap around services required by residents.
